Scenario: Login with valid username and password
Preconditions: Demo app is open at app/index.html
Test Steps: '"1. Enter username 2. Enter password 3. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Login succeeds; dashboard view shows 'Welcome, admin!'
Remarks: Executed manually; also automated by LoginTest.validLoginShouldOpenDashboard

Scenario: Login with valid username and wrong password
Test Steps: '"1. Enter valid username 2. Enter wrong password 3. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Error 'Invalid password.' is shown; dashboard stays hidden
Remarks: Executed manually; dashboard did not open

Scenario: Login with unknown username and valid password
Test Steps: '"1. Enter unknown username 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login"'

Scenario: Login with both username and password empty
Test Steps: '"1. Leave both fields blank 2. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Error 'Username and password are required.' is shown

Scenario: Login with empty username and valid password
Test Steps: '"1. Leave username blank 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login"'

Scenario: Login with valid username and empty password
Test Steps: '"1. Enter valid username 2. Leave password blank 3. Click Login"'
'"1. Enter a 2-character username 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Error 'Username must be at least 3 characters.' is shown
Actual Result: Username must be at least 3 characters.
Remarks: Executed manually; lower boundary of username (min 3)

Test Steps: '"1. Enter a 3-character unknown username 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Passes length check; error 'Invalid username.' is shown
Remarks: Executed manually; upper boundary of username length rule

Test Steps: '"1. Enter valid username 2. Enter a 5-character password 3. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Error 'Password must be at least 6 characters.' is shown
Actual Result: Password must be at least 6 characters.
Remarks: Executed manually; lower boundary of password (min 6)

Test Steps: '"1. Enter valid username 2. Enter a 6-character wrong password 3. Click Login"'
Expected Result: Passes length check; error 'Invalid password.' is shown
Remarks: Executed manually; upper boundary of password length rule

Test Steps: '"1. Enter a SQL/script style string as username 2. Enter any password 3. Click Login"'

Scenario: Username with leading and trailing spaces is trimmed
Test Steps: '"1. Enter username surrounded by spaces 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login"'
Remarks: Executed manually; app trims username before validation

Test Steps: '"1. Type characters into the password field 2. Observe the field"'
Expected Result: Characters are shown as dots, not plain text
Actual Result: Dots displayed instead of the password characters

Scenario: Successful logout returns to login page
Test Steps: '"1. Click the Logout button 2. Observe the page"'
Expected Result: Dashboard hides; login form returns with 'You have been logged out.'

Scenario: Submit the login form using the Enter key
Test Steps: '"1. Enter valid username 2. Enter valid password 3. Press Enter"'
Actual Result: Form submitted via Enter; login succeeded
